business.headline: Bitcoin surges 12% crosses $70,000: 5 key drivers behind the rallyThe world's largest cryptocurrency was trading at $71,933.44 at the time of writing, at around 3.15 pm, up 11.8% over the previous 24 hours.

Sensex closes over 600 points higher, Nifty above 24,200; Eternal gains over 2%The rebound came after a bruising run for Dalal Street, with the Nifty having fallen for seven straight sessions before Thursday as elevated crude oil prices and rising global bond yields hurt risk appetite.

Aditya Birla Capital enters gold loan business, shares jump 3%Aditya Birla Capital plans to open 200-300 dedicated gold loan branches by March 2027 across markets it considers to have strong potential.

NBCC scraps e-auction of 262 premium residential units in Delhi's ChanakyapuriNBCC has cancelled the e-auction of freehold residential units at Avenue Towers on Africa Avenue. The company has offered full refunds, including the processing fee, while giving no fresh auction date.

Adani Enterprises makes a strong comeback, emerges as Nifty 50's top gainerAdani Enterprises has re-emerged as one of the Nifty50's strongest performers as large investors and lenders raise exposure to the group. Gold nears Rs 1.60 lakh, silver crosses Rs 2.4 lakh: What should investors do now?Gold is knocking on the door of Rs 1.60 lakh, while silver has comfortably crossed Rs 2.4 lakh. As precious metals extend their gains, investors are weighing their next move.

From Covid vaccine to cancer breakthrough, Moderna's 177% surge explainedModerna's shares soared during the Covid vaccine boom before crashing as demand faded. A cancer breakthrough has now triggered the company's biggest-ever one-day gain, with the stock jumping 177%. Now, investors are asking whether cancer could give Moderna the next big growth story it has been searching for.

Sensex jumps over 550 points at open, Nifty above 24,200 as IT stocks leadThe BSE Sensex rose 554.88 points, or 0.72%, to 77,464.56 at around 9:36 am. The Nifty 50 gained 127.30 points, or 0.53%, to 24,205.60, after touching an early high of 24,225.45.

HUL takes Beco to Delhi HC over harmful chemicals claims against Surf Excel, VimHUL has approached the Delhi High Court against Beco's campaign targeting Surf Excel and Vim. The court has sought Beco's reply and will hear both sides before deciding interim relief.

India replaces Indonesia as Asia's least-preferred stock marketA Bank of America (BofA) survey found India has replaced Indonesia as Asia's least-preferred stock market. The result underlines investor unease over valuations, growth and limited AI exposure despite better earnings.

Can money really buy happiness? A report puts a number to itA latest report estimates India's income satiation level at about Rs 20 lakh a year. The finding suggests extra earnings matter less to life evaluation after that point.

Your SBI FDs may earn less after latest rate cut: Check new ratesSBI has cut interest rates by 25 basis points (bps) on domestic bulk term deposits of Rs 3 crore and above for select tenures. The revised rates came into effect on August 15, 2026, according to the bank's website.

IndiGo website hit by glitch, passengers unable to book ticketsPassengers trying to book IndiGo flights online reported technical problems with flight availability on the airline's website. In some cases, users saw a 'No Data Available' message, signalling a disruption in the booking process.
Sensex, Nifty slide as crude hits 3-week high, bond yields riseThe Nifty 50 fell 76.60 points, or 0.32%, to close at 24,078.30, while the BSE Sensex declined 325.78 points, or 0.42%, to 76,909.68.

Zepto's free delivery minimum rises to Rs 199, at par with Blinkit, SwiggyZepto has hiked its free-delivery minimum order value to Rs 199 from Rs 149 in select areas, joining rivals Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart as quick-commerce companies seek to improve profitability.

entertainment.headline: BB 20: Narrator Vijay Vikram Singh gets calls for entry, issues warning Bigg Boss narrator Vijay Vikram Singh revealed that he has been flooded with messages from people hoping to join the reality show. He warned aspiring contestants that anyone promising to secure them an entry is lying.

Ranveer Singh's father meets producers' body amid Don 3 row, submits plea Ranveer Singh's father Jagjit Singh Bhavnani met the Indian Motion Picture Producers Association and submitted a plea against Excel Entertainment's Rs 45 crore claim in the Don 3 dispute. The association will examine the documents before deciding its next step.

Why fans think Toxic's English trailer is better than what they released in India Yash's Toxic English trailer has fans comparing it with the earlier language versions, with many saying the English cut feels more natural and seamless. From Yash's dialogue delivery to the trailer's overall rhythm, viewers feel the English version gives the film a more global feel.

Ranbir Kapoor to start Brahmastra 2 in April. Will Deepika Padukone join? Filmmaker Ayan Mukerji is in talks with actor Deepika Padukone for Brahmastra 2. Reportedly, the actor will play the role of Amruta alongside Ranbir Kapoor's Shiva and Alia Bhatt's Isha.

Kacha Badam star Anjali Arora visits Kainchi Dham amid Ramayan Katha backlash. Pics Anjali Arora visited Kainchi Dham and shared pictures after seeking Neem Karoli Baba's blessings. The post comes as her casting as Goddess Sita in Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha remains under online scrutiny.

When did Govinda-Ssunita's 39-year marriage become a public spectacle? A timeline Actor Govinda and Ssunita Ahuja's 39-year marriage has increasingly become a talking point, with old relationship rumours, public allegations and their recent back-and-forth bringing their private life into the spotlight.

Netflix sued by metal band Demon Hunter over KPop Demon Hunters title American metal band Demon Hunter has sued Netflix, Netflix Studios and AEG Presents over KPop Demon Hunters. The case centres on alleged consumer confusion as the franchise expands into music, merchandise and live shows.
Shweta Tiwari tags Tukaram Mundhe after cockroach found in online delivery Actor Shweta Tiwari tagged Maharashtra FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe after she found a cockroach in her online order.

Toxic English trailer is 11 seconds shorter than Indian version. What has changed? Yash's Toxic has unveiled separate English and Indian trailers with small but noticeable changes. The differences sharpen attention on the film's global rollout and its father-son conflict.

Prime Video accidentally releases Jason Statham's Mutiny in US, fans shocked Amazon Prime Video briefly showed Jason Statham's Mutiny in full on its US platform before the film's exclusive cinema release. The apparent leak has raised fresh questions about high-profile movie security on major tech platforms.

Why Operation Safed Sagar ends every episode with a Raju Srivastav tribute Every episode of Operation Safed Sagar ends with a thank-you note to Raju Srivastav. The tribute reflects his role in backing Kushal Srivastava and the family's journey with the series.

No one can buy me: Rajpal Yadav says money can't define his 26-year journey Rajpal Yadav said his financial and legal troubles do not define him as an artist. He said his bond with cinema and theatre remains unchanged despite the dispute.

Kacha Badam girl Anjali Arora plays Sita in Ramayan Katha, internet not impressed Content creator Anjali Arora's casting as Goddess Sita in Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha has stirred online debate, drawing mixed reactions from social media users. While some question the choice and visual effects, others compare the film to Adipurush, highlighting the strong sentiments around this retelling of the epic Ramayana.

January 12 Vidudala: Venkatesh's film puts its release date right in the title Anil Ravipudi has unveiled January 12 Vidudala as the title of his Venkatesh and Kalyan Ram film. The playful announcement fixes the film in the Sankranthi 2027 race and hints at a brothers-in-law dynamic.

Awarapan 2 box office Day 6: Emraan's biggest opener is now in Rs 150-crore club Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 has crossed Rs 150 crore globally within six days despite a dip in daily collections. The film maintains a strong box office hold and is expected to surge past Rs 150-crore India nett milestone soon.

Why Ramayana's trolled VFX suddenly look good next to Avengers: Doomsday Online reaction to Avengers: Doomsday's new footage has unexpectedly shifted attention to Ramayana's visual effects. The reversal shows how quickly audience perception changes when Hollywood faces the same scrutiny as Indian cinema.

Batwara 1947 box office Day 6: Domestic earnings lose steam, films hits Rs 45 crore Batwara 1947 opened strong during the Independence Day holiday, collecting Rs 45.42 crore worldwide in six days but is now facing a sharp decline on weekdays. The Rajkumar Santoshi-directed film, starring Sunny Deol, is competing with Awarapan 2.

Viswanath and Sons box office Day 6: Just Rs 15 crore away from Rs 150-crore club Suriya and Mamitha Baiju's Vishwanath And Sons earned an estimated Rs 5.10 crore India nett on Day 6, taking its worldwide gross to Rs 135.49 crore. The collections dipped from Tuesday, but the film held steady across Tamil and Telugu markets.

Apoorva Makhija says she moved to New York to escape fame, online pressure Apoorva said she moved to New York for an MBA at NYU Stern while stepping back from the demands of being The Rebel Kid online. She said the shift will help her understand business better and prepare for building a D2C brand in India.

general news.headline: Cauvery, NEET, delimitation dominate South Chief Ministers' meet with Amit ShahSouth CMs made a pitch that the region's economic contribution must be matched by political representation, fiscal fairness, infrastructure support and a greater voice in national policymaking.

Did RAF fire non-existent plastic pellets at CJP protesters?Two cartridges with plastic pellets were fired at protesters by the Rapid Action Force (RAF) of the CRPF during the July 20 Parliament march in New Delhi, said a general diary entry. But no expert has ever seen plastic pellets, heard of them being used, or encountered a victim injured by them. Here's what we got after a month-long chase of the mysterious pellets.

Don't penalise South: Vijay's two big demands at CMs' meet with Amit ShahChief Minister Vijay, making his maiden appearance at the Southern Zonal Council meeting, stuck to the two issues that have recently been at the heart of Tamil Nadu politics.

Secret deal behind Imran Khan's hospital transfer? Pak journalist's big theoryThe Pakistan Supreme Court's order to shift jailed Imran Khan to a private hospital after three years has sparked unease within the Shehbaz Sharif-led government. Senior Pakistani journalist Hamid Mir explains why.

Only Indians, Americans allowed: Pak MP claims UAE hotel snub after cancelled flightPakistani travellers were denied hotel accommodation after a UAE flight cancellation while Indian and US passport holders were accommodated, a Pak MP alleged in the National Assembly.

It's not data that is the new scarce, and yet essential, commodity. Instead, it is RAM and, as Zoho boss Sridhar Vembu has noted, it is doing to the world what oil has done for years.

US body seeks sanctions on RSS. It's led by Pak-origin man with Kashmir historyThe USCIRF, a US federal religious-freedom body, has called for sanctions against the RSS, weeks before Mohan Bhagwat's planned visit to America. The USCIRF is led by Pakistan-born chairperson Asif Mahmood, who has previously testified before the US Congress on Kashmir.

YouTuber gets friend to pose as a beggar in Haridwar. Here's how much he earnedA YouTuber made his friend pose as a beggar at Haridwar's Kawad Mela and ask for money from devotees. Their day's earnings have left social media users stunned.

Trehan has now promised a three-day comeback, weather and crowds permitting.

Kyrgios was one of Halep's fiercest critics during her doping case, making his current predicament all the more striking.

Investigators tracked them through CCTV footage, her final "Babu" clue and bloodstained currency notes recovered from one of the accused.

El Nino yet to fully arrive. It has already done enough damageThe Pacific is warming at a worrying pace and the consequences of it are already rippling across the world, from crop stress and wildfires to shifting rainfall patterns worldwide.

Congress insulting freedom fighters: Amit Shah attacks party's Vande Mataram standAmit Shah accused Congress of "appeasement politics" over its refusal to follow the protocol for singing the full Vande Mataram at government functions. He alleged the 1937 decision to split the song contributed to Partition and said Congress had insulted Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay and freedom fighters.

Private Ganga aarti and then a spa: What luxury moksha looks likeFrom Char Dham helicopter journeys to private Ganga Aarti and exclusive puja experiences, spirituality and pilgrimage now come soaked in luxury.

The tit-for-tat move came days after Pakistan removed security barriers outside the Indian High Commission in Islamabad.

Goodbye Niketu Iralu: Peace icon who emerged from cradle of Naga armed rebellionNagaland today bid adieu to iconic peace activist Niketu Iralu who died this week. For over six decades, Iralu had been offering a healing touch to the fractured Naga society. He was born in Khonoma, the village where Angami Zapu Phizo, father of Naga insurgency, was born. Iralu was related to Phizo but took a very different path.

Mumbai model who stopped police van seeks FIR withdrawal, action against threatsModel Riya Ahir has sought strict action against those threatening her online. The Mumbai police assured a delegation that the matter will be addressed.

Kyrgios was one of Halep's fiercest critics during her doping case, making his current predicament all the more striking.

Monty Desai steps down as Canada coach amid corruption scandal Monty Desai has left as interim head coach of Canada after three months in charge. His exit comes with Canada cricket under ICC scrutiny and still chasing World Cup qualification.

Max Verstappen locked down by Red Bull until 2030 amid struggling F1 season Max Verstappen has ended months of uncertainty over his Formula 1 future by extending his Red Bull contract until 2030, backing the team to return to championship contention after a difficult start to the new regulations.

Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly shock 7th seeds, one win away from medal BWF World Championships: India's Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly shocked the 7th seed Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi in their Round of 16 clash on Thursday, August 20. They are now one win away from a medal at the World Championships.

Hockey World Cup: Can Indian women create history and top Pool D? India's women face England with a first-ever Pool D finish within reach. The match could decide whether India can win the group or exit from the competition altogether.

Ayush Shetty, PV Sindhu face their toughest opponents yet, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty play their first game.

Manav Suthar reminds India what classical spin looks like Manav Suthar's 10-wicket haul in Galle showcased the qualities of classical Test spin, with the young left-armer using drift, overspin, bounce, pace and subtle variations to dismantle Sri Lanka.

Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue split match-ball after Pakistan rout Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue split the match ball after sharing five-wicket hauls against Pakistan at Headingley. The gesture capped England's rout of Pakistan for 171 and highlighted Robinson's strong comeback.

Then he beat LakshyaGarret Tan arrived in Delhi as an 18-year-old American ranked 92nd in the world, with little more than a first World Championships experience in mind. Josh Tongue explains England's 'brave' approach behind Pakistan collapseJosh Tongue said England's bowlers had to be brave with their lengths after Pakistan were dismissed for 171 at Headingley. His five-wicket haul, alongside Ollie Robinson's return spell, left England 112/2 and firmly in control.

Ederson still puzzled by failed Manchester United moveEderson remains puzzled by Manchester United's decision to abandon his summer transfer despite insisting his medical went well. AIFF defends Brazil clash, rubbishes claims of ASEAN Cup penalty claimsThe AIFF has stood by its decision to prioritise India's Brazil friendly, while rejecting claims of a predetermined financial penalty for withdrawing from the ASEAN Cup and questioning unverified figures surrounding its finances.

ISL to start in October with 13 teams after Diamond Harbour miss deadlineThe Indian Super League (ISL) is set to begin in October with 13 teams after Diamond Harbour FC failed to meet the deadline to submit the required documents for the upcoming season. The club's absence means the league will proceed with a reduced number of teams.

Sri Lanka vs India: Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal to miss Colombo TestSri Lanka head coach Gary Kirsten confirmed that the hosts will be without Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal for the second Test against India in Colombo. BCCI shifts Duleep Trophy final from Bengaluru to Chennai to allow spectatorsThe BCCI has shifted the Duleep Trophy 2026-27 final from the Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru to the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai, allowing spectators to attend the marquee domestic fixture.
